mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_account_usage (account_id, account_code, tenant_id, user_id, operator_name, execution_id, task_id, chain_code, data_pool_code, usage_type, status, started_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{accountCode}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{operatorName}, #{executionId}, #{taskId}, #{chainCode}, #{dataPoolCode}, #{usageType}, #{status}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_account_usage SET status = #{status}, ended_at = NOW(), duration_ms = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, NOW()) DIV 1000, release_reason = #{releaseReason} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_account_usage WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_account_usage WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
